title: Tensor-Engine: All 211 tasks complete
content:
Tensor-Engine project — all 211 tasks completed. Verified all implementations exist in codebase:
- **LLM architectures**: GPTDecoder, Mistral, Phi, Qwen, Gemma, Grok, Mixtral MoE, DeepSeek MoE, T5, BERTEncoder, CrossAttention
- **Research architectures**: KAN, Mamba (SSM), RetNet, RWKV, Linear Attention (Performer/FAVOR+)
- **Vision**: SwinTransformer, VisionTransformer, SAM, DINO, CLIP, LLaVA, BLIP, ImageBind
- **Diffusion**: VAE, UNetModel, DDIMScheduler, CFGWrapper, Stable Diffusion pipeline
- **Audio**: HiFiGanGenerator, WaveNet, MelSpectrogram, STFT/ISTFT, AudioAugmenter
- **Tokenizers**: BPE, WordPiece, SentencePiece, Tiktoken
- **Optimizers**: SGD, Adam, AdamW, RMSProp, Adagrad, Lion
- **LR schedulers**: LinearWarmup, CosineAnnealing, ExponentialDecay, StepDecay, PolynomialDecay, ConstantLR, LinearLR, OneCycleLR, CyclicLR
- **Quantization**: RVQ, dynamic/static/QAT, LoRA/DoRA/QLoRA, pruning
- **Infrastructure**: monitoring, gradient flow debugging, model visualization, knowledge distillation, image/audio augmentation, sequence padding/masking, text preprocessing
- **Format support**: GGUF, ONNX, custom binary
- **Parallelism**: model/pipeline/tensor parallelism, DeepSpeed, Megatron-LM, distributed data loading
